# SYNESIS_E116 — Error

## Description

`concept_a`: label `term` is the name of the concept `example`.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The label `term` of `concept_a` is the name of the concept `example`.
  A label cannot be another concept with a block. If both name the same
  thing, consolidate them with USE (synesis-coder consolidate).
```
